Local rules that affect duplexes in New Westminster

items.t: Zoning (New Westminster): New Westminster Zoning Bylaw 6680 (2001) governs; the OCP governing is Bylaw 7925 (2017), with the City's Interim Development Review Framework (first endorsed 2024, updated June 2026) governing how applications are reviewed while policy changes are underway. The zone of a specific lot is not confirmed until read.

SSMUH / infill position (New Westminster): Queensborough SSMUH compliance runs on the extended provincial timeline to May 4, 2029. A duplex is the baseline two-unit form; infill potential does not by itself split a duplex into separately titled halves.

North Arm = Zone 2. Glenbrooke North + Queen's Park: Not verified — no zone is imported for either. Pull the specific property's flood construction level and insurance position before subjects come off.

faq.q: Is Queensborough part of New Westminster?
faq.a: Yes — Queensborough is a New Westminster board sub-area and city neighbourhood across the Fraser River from the mainland city; it carried the city's largest detached shelf in September 2026 (41 listings, 1 sale, 2%) and its own schools confirmed in the Ministry file, Queen Elizabeth Elementary (921 Salter St) and Queensborough Middle School (833 Salter St) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How many units can a New Westminster house lot hold?
faq.a: Since June 2026, OCP and Zoning Bylaw amendments permit up to six units of infill housing — suites, laneway and carriage houses, triplex, quadplex and other multiplex forms — on single detached and duplex properties across most of the city, under RGO-A (up to four units) and RGO-B (up to six units) zoning, without a site-specific rezoning.

faq.q: When are property taxes due in New Westminster?
faq.a: For 2026, City of New Westminster property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to current taxes remaining (including unclaimed Home Owner Grants) on July 3, 2026, and a second 5% penalty applies to any unpaid balance on September 3, 2026.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in New Westminster?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 151 houses listed in New Westminster and 15 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in New Westminster?
faq.a: The October report gave $1,350,000 for houses in New Westminster, against $1,365,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in New Westminster?
faq.a: The October report showed 23 days on market for houses in New Westminster and a sale-to-list price ratio of 96%, against 35 days the month before.
